required_facts: Healer returns ships after they have entered the warp; this can trigger Remora.

Vacuum has already lost ships to the warp and can use its power before healing.
Healer may then heal other eligible affected ships, but not its own ships.

answer.text: Whether Healer prevents warp arrival or retrieves after arrival, and whether Remora can trigger.
answer.answer: Healer returns ships after they reach the warp. That arrival can trigger Remora’s retrieval.

answer.text: Whether Healer can heal ordinary Zombie prevention.
answer.answer: No. It cannot heal Zombie ships that were prevented from arriving in the warp.

answer.text: Whether Vacuum acts before healing, and whether its victims can then be healed.
answer.answer: Vacuum triggers before Healer. Healer may then heal Vacuum and its other affected players separately, but never itself.

original_unit.text:
#### Healer

**Heal — As any player; optional; Start Turn, Regroup, Destiny, Launch, Alliance, Planning, Reveal, Resolution.**

- When ANOTHER player loses ships to warp or has ships removed from game, may return ALL ships just lost to that player and earn one deck card.
- Healing does not prevent compensation. Healed player replaces ships on any of their colonies.
- During encounter may heal several players, drawing one card for each.

**FAQ pp3,15,22:** Ships reach warp before being healed, allowing compensation and Remora's retrieval trigger. You cannot heal Zombie ships prevented from arriving. Vacuum triggers before healing, and you may then heal Vacuum and its other affected players separately, but never yourself.
